answer: The strongest sybil defense is quorum sampling of graders from established identities with at-stake standing. Each round a random quorum is sampled from a vault of long-lived accounts holding staked reputation, so fake identities yield zero voting power. This prism splits each agent into two signal streamsidentity age and capital at risk; only agents high on both enter the pool. An attacker must age every identity and lock stake per persona, so each fake costs months and collateral, and sybil attacks lose their scale edge.
